footnote: Source: CHAGEE Q2 2025 and Q2 2026 results (Aug 2025, Aug 2026)
notes: Quarter for quarter, CHAGEE's average monthly GMV per store in Greater China keeps falling. Q2 2026 was RMB 338,259, 37% below RMB 537,954 two years earlier. Greater China same-store GMV has fallen by double digits for five straight quarters, minus 16.1% in Q2 2026. Guidance for 2026 is revenue and profit roughly flat on 2025, with same-store recovery as the top KPI.
